# Measured weights for the internal/testing/e2e catch-all shards
# (test-e2e-other.yml), in seconds.
#
# `TestName seconds` per line; `#` comments and blanks ignored. A name with no
# entry weighs 1, so this file steers BALANCE only: scripts/shard-tests
# partitions the live list and cmd/ci-test-workers splits a shard between its
# workers, and every listed name lands in exactly one bucket whatever its
# weight. A stale weight costs an unevenly filled shard, nothing more.
#
# The lane's tests are mostly sub-second, except the TestRunner*ExamplePasses
# suites, which run a tests/stdlib file under the Go interpreter: the TLS,
# QUIC, compression and public-key suites take minutes each. Split by count
# they bunched, and one x86 shard reached the 25m budget while another
# finished in 7m (#12644's run 39113909934: 25.5, 14.4, 11.0 and 7.2 min).
#
# Measured 2026-10-18 on the 4-core dev container with other work beside it,
# `go test ./internal/testing/e2e -run 'TestRunner.*ExamplePasses$' -v`; the
# CI runner reads lower, and the ratio between rows is what the partition
# uses. Every suite at 10 s or more is listed.
